notes.title: New Easter levels - find the eggs before the stalker finds you
notes.content: Easter is here, and what better way to celebrate than with an Easter egg hunt. The latest update for Deadly Footprints contains a set of 10 brand new levels in which you have to find all the Eggs before you can escape. Each level contains more eggs than the previous one. Can you find them all before the stalker finds you?

notes.title: Deadly Footprints release date announcement
notes.content: I just received confirmation that the build of Deadly Footprints has been approved for release on Steam, so I can finally announce the release date, which is now set for February 14. What better way to celebrate Valentine's Day than by running away from a homicidal maniac with a knife?

notes.title: Deadly Footprints demo is live.
notes.content: The playable demo for Deadly Footprints is now available to download. This demo contains the first 20 levels of the game. Try it out and let me know what you think.
